mutation: The deny branch taken on a session-store miss, malformed entry, or expired session (find_sentry==0 || iStack_17c<0 || uVar1<now) returns a valid privilege level 0 instead of 0xffffffff (-1), so an absent or expired session is treated as an authenticated top-level user.
why: sess_validate is the session gate. Its return is emitted by phpcgi_main as AUTHORIZED_GROUP=%d and tested by sess_ispoweruser (<100). The correct gate fails closed (returns -1) when the session is missing or expired. Forcing that path to a valid level (0) grants unauthenticated/expired callers a valid, top-privilege session identity.
